posts.title: Slicce is launched
posts.intro: We are excited to introduce Slicce; Self-containted Lightweight Cloud Communication Engines.
posts.body:
A platform that enables you to create and deploy microservices for telecom core network applications. Slicce's communication engines are scalable, secure, and easy to use.

Slicce's communication engines can help you achieve faster time-to-market, lower operational costs, and better customer experience.
posts.author: Slicce
